scenes.speaker: alice
scenes.text: What does the future of AI look like?

scenes.speaker: bob
scenes.text: It is not just about smarter models.

scenes.speaker: alice
scenes.text: It is about AI that can reason, plan, and act.

scenes.speaker: bob
scenes.text: Imagine AI agents that can use tools autonomously.

scenes.speaker: alice
scenes.text: They could write code, design systems, and create art.

scenes.speaker: bob
scenes.text: But with great power comes great responsibility.

scenes.speaker: alice
scenes.text: We need alignment. We need safety. We need trust.

scenes.speaker: bob
scenes.text: The future is not AI versus humans.

scenes.speaker: alice
scenes.text: It is humans and AI, working together.

scenes.speaker: bob
scenes.text: That is the future worth building.
